title: 日本ダービーの後に・Die Faszination

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite failing to win, Eishin Flash's performance charmed the crowd. Her parents also encourage her and look forward to her future success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once again, lofty ambitions for victory stir within her. We agree to continue with her plan to complete all her scheduled races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, due to a health concern, I decide to remove the Classic Triple Crown's final race, the Kikuka Sho, from her schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her perfectly constructed plan is now in ruins. This new reality throws Eishin Flash's spirit into chaos.
